name: vendor.myndhyve.market-intel-voc
description: MyndHyve market-intel.voc-extraction — extract Voice of Customer records (verbatim quotes + tagType + intentStage + confidence + rationale) from one piece of content (one AI call) or from the pages a chain fetched (one AI call per page, ADR 1116). First marketIntel pack of the Stage 5 cohort. Schema validation strips invalid records with per-record warnings; output preserves source structure (records + summary + warnings).
author: MyndHyve

nodes.label: Extract Voice of Customer
nodes.description: Content lane: one AI call against `content` + ICP/product context. Pages lane (ADR 1116): given `core.web.fetch` `pages`, one AI call per readable page (default 3, cap 5), records stamped with their page and merged. Every source body reaches the model inside the untrusted-content fence. Output is validated closed-world (6 tag types × 4 intent stages × clamped confidence, and each quote must be verbatim from its source); invalid records are dropped with warnings. A pages run that keeps no record fails typed (VOC_NO_RECORDS), never succeeds empty.
